elaboration-studio-agentic-hub-resources.description: Build, lint, test, and package the Agentic Hub VS Code extension using its pnpm workspace.
Discover, lock, install, and sync public skills with npx skills and .skill-lock.json — same workflow as ~/.agentic-arno, aligned with skills.sh and skills-lock.json.

elaboration-studio-agentic-hub-agents-ru.description: Guide for writing idiomatic Rust code based on Apollo GraphQL's best practices handbook. Use this skill when: (1) writing new Rust code or functions, (2) reviewing or refactoring existing Rust code, (3) deciding between borrowing vs cloning or ownership patterns, (4) implementing error handling with Result types, (5) optimizing Rust code for performance, (6) writing tests or documentation for Rust projects.
elaboration-studio-agentic-hub-agents-ru.author: apollographql
elaboration-studio-agentic-hub-agents-ru.tools: Bash(cargo:*) Bash(rustc:*) Bash(rustfmt:*) Bash(clippy:*) Read Write Edit Glob Grep

elaboration-studio-agentic-hub-agents-ta.description: Tauri v2+ cross-platform app development with Rust backend. Use when configuring tauri.conf.json, implementing Rust commands (#[tauri::command]), setting up IPC patterns (invoke, emit, channels), configuring permissions/capabilities, troubleshooting build issues, or deploying desktop/mobile apps. Triggers on Tauri, src-tauri, invoke, emit, capabilities.json.
